import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port  # noqa: E402


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 8080 "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535  "), 65535)

    def test_long_run_of_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 5000 + "22"), 22)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejected(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_below_range(self):
        self.assertRejected("0")
        self.assertRejected("000")
        self.assertRejected(" 0 ")

    def test_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejected("65536")
        self.assertRejected("99999")
        self.assertRejected("100000")
        self.assertRejected("0065536")

    def test_empty_and_space_only(self):
        self.assertRejected("")
        self.assertRejected(" ")
        self.assertRejected("     ")

    def test_signs(self):
        self.assertRejected("+80")

import unittest

from src.solution import parse_port


class ParsePortTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_boundaries_accepted(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)

    def test_just_outside_boundaries_rejected(self):
        for text in ["0", "65536", "99999"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0000000000000000443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)

    def test_leading_zeros_do_not_make_zero_valid(self):
        for text in ["00", "000000"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   8080   "), 8080)

    def test_invalid_inputs_rejected(self):
        cases = [
            "",
            "   ",
            "+80",
            "-1",
            "\t80",
            "80\t",
            "80\n",
            "\n80",
            " 8\t0",
            "1.5",
            "80.0",
            "1 000",
            "1_000",
            "0x50",
            "80a",
            "a80",
            "٤٤",      # Arabic-Indic digits
            "８０",      # fullwidth digits
            "¹°",      # superscript digits
        ]
        for text in cases:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(text)

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        for value in [None, 80, 80.0, b"80", ["80"], True]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_port(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_just_inside_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("2"), 2)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)

    def test_common_port(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("  443 "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535  "), 65535)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("000065535"), 65535)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejected(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejected("0")
        self.assertRejected("00")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejected("65536")
        self.assertRejected("099999")

    def test_large_values(self):
        self.assertRejected("99999")
        self.assertRejected("100000")
        self.assertRejected("4294967296")

    def test_empty_and_blank(self):
        self.assertRejected("")
        self.assertRejected(" ")
        self.assertRejected("   ")

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("+80")
        self.assertRejected("-80")
        self.assertRejected("+0")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("\t80")
        self.assertRejected("80\t")
        self.assertRejected("\n80")
        self.assertRejected("80\n")
        self.assertRejected("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejected("8 0")

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("80.0")
        self.assertRejected(".80")
        self.assertRejected("80.")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("٨٠")      # Arabic-Indic digits 8 0
        self.assertRejected("８０")      # fullwidth digits 8 0
        self.assertRejected("²")            # superscript two
        self.assertRejected("8 080")        # non-breaking space inside

    def test_non_ascii_space_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(" 80")
        self.assertRejected("80　")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(None)
        self.assertRejected(80)
        self.assertRejected(80.0)
        self.assertRejected(b"80")
        self.assertRejected(["80"])
        self.assertRejected(True)

    def test_embedded_non_digit_characters_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("8a")
        self.assertRejected("0x50")
        self.assertRejected("1_000")
        self.assertRejected("80 80")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import random
import unittest

from solution import topological_order


class TopologicalOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertValidOrder(self, order, nodes, edges):
        self.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
        self.assertEqual(len(order), len(set(order)))
        position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
        for a, b in edges:
            self.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"{a} must precede {b}")

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assertValidOrder(order, nodes, [])

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        self.assertValidOrder(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["lone", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertValidOrder(order, nodes, edges)
        self.assertIn("lone", order)

    def test_three_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_cycle_unreachable_from_sources_raises(self):
        nodes = ["s", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("s", "a"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_with_other_edges_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertValidOrder(order, nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_still_detect_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("c", "d")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_when_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_accepts_generator_of_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, ((x, y) for x, y in [("a", "b")]))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b"])

    def test_random_dags_produce_valid_orders(self):
        rng = random.Random(12345)
        for _ in range(200):
            n = rng.randint(1, 30)
            nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(n)]
            shuffled = nodes[:]
            rng.shuffle(shuffled)
            edges = []
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    if rng.random() < 0.2:
                        edges.append((shuffled[i], shuffled[j]))
            rng.shuffle(edges)
            order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
            self.assertValidOrder(order, nodes, edges)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import copy
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import topological_order


def assert_valid_order(test, order, nodes, edges):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for before, after in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[before], position[after], f"{before} must precede {after}")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, nodes, edges):
        nodes_copy = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_copy = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_copy)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_copy)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):
        order = self.check(["a", "b", "c"], [])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(order), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_chain(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.check(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.check(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        self.check(["x", "a", "y", "b", "z"], [("a", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        self.check(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_in_larger_graph(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "c"), ("a", "c")]
        self.check(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_alongside_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("c", "c")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c", "d"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")])

    def test_cycle_with_isolated_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["free", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_accepts_list_edges(self):
        self.check(["a", "b"], [["a", "b"]])

    def test_large_chain_does_not_recurse(self):
        n = 100_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order, nodes)

    def test_large_cycle_raises(self):
        n = 100_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[(i + 1) % n]) for i in range(n)]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, order, nodes, edges):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(set(order)))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"{a} must precede {b}")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, [])

    def test_single_node_no_edges(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(["a"], []), ["a"])

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_isolated_mixed_with_connected(self):
        nodes = ["solo", "b", "a", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, edges)
        self.assertIn("solo", order)

    def test_disconnected_components(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("b", "a"), ("d", "c")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, edges)

    def test_edges_given_as_lists(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [["a", "b"]]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_with_acyclic_part_raises(self):
        nodes = ["root", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("root", "a"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_with_cycle_still_raise(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_long_chain_no_recursion_limit(self):
        n = 50_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def insert(self, rows):
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def test_matches_prefix(self):
        self.insert([(1, "alice"), (2, "albert"), (3, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al", 10), [(2, "albert"), (1, "alice")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.insert([(1, "100%off"), (2, "100 off"), (3, "1000")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%off")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.insert([(1, "a_b"), (2, "axb")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.insert([(1, "a\\b"), (2, "ab")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\b")])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.insert([(1, "x\\%y"), (2, "x%y"), (3, "xzy")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x\\%", 10), [(1, "x\\%y")])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_plain_text(self):
        self.insert([(1, "alice"), (2, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 2)

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.insert([(3, "sam"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (9, "sad")])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "sa", 10),
            [(9, "sad"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")],
        )

    def test_limit_is_applied_after_ordering(self):
        self.insert([(3, "c"), (1, "a"), (2, "b")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "", 2), [(1, "a"), (2, "b")])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_of_one(self):
        self.insert([(1, "a"), (2, "b")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "", 0), [(1, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "", -5), [(1, "a")])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_of_100(self):
        self.insert([(i, f"user{i:03d}") for i in range(1, 151)])
        rows = search(self.conn, "user", 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (1, "user001"))
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1], (100, "user100"))

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        self.insert([(1, "a")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        self.insert([(1, "a")])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, 1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_matches_prefix(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "alan", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(2, "alan"), (1, "alice")])

    def test_does_not_match_infix(self):
        conn = make_db(["xalice", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "ali", 10), [(2, "alice")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100%", "100x", "abc"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [(1, "100%")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_c", "abc", "a_"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(3, "a_"), (1, "a_c")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\b")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "\\", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 10)), 2)

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["sam", "sam", "sam", "sad"])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "s", 10),
            [(4, "sad"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")],
        )

    def test_limit_applied(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 2)), 2)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"n{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "n", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limits(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in (True, False, 1.0, "5", None, [1]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_conn(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, start=1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prefix_match_returns_id_and_name(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob", "alfred"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(1, "alice"), (3, "alfred")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["100%", "100 apples", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%")])

    def test_percent_alone_does_not_match_everything(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a_b", "axb", "a_"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(3, "a_"), (1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\b")])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["x\\%y", "x\\zz", "xq"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x\\%", 10), [(1, "x\\%y")])

    def test_injection_payload_is_treated_as_text(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "alice'); DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone(), (2,))

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_names(self):
        conn = make_conn(["bob", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(2, "alice"), (1, "bob")])

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id_for_ties(self):
        conn = make_conn(["sam", "sam", "sam", "amy"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(4, "amy"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (3, "sam")])

    def test_limit_applies_after_ordering(self):
        conn = make_conn(["c", "a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(2, "a"), (3, "b")])

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 0), [(2, "a")][:1] or [(2, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -50)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_max_is_clamped_to_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 500)), 100)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 100)), 100)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 99)), 99)

    def test_bool_limit_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_non_int_limit_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_str_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, None, 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":

        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al_", 10), [(4, "al_ce")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al\\", 10), [(5, "al\\ce")])

    def test_wildcard_only_prefixes_match_literal_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a%", 10), [(7, "a%")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a_", 10), [(8, "a_")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 10), [(9, "a\\")])

    def test_sql_injection_string_is_treated_as_data(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, len(ROWS))

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), len(ROWS))

    def test_matching_is_ascii_case_insensitive_like_before(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "ali", 10), [(2, "Alicia"), (1, "alice")])

    def test_ties_ordered_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "adam", 10), [(10, "adam"), (20, "adam")])

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_max_is_clamped_to_100(self):
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(1000 + i, "user%03d" % i) for i in range(150)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "user", 500)), 100)

    def test_bool_and_non_integer_limits_are_rejected(self):
        for bad in (True, False, 1.0, "5", None):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import search


def make_conn(rows):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prefix_match_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_conn([(3, "alice"), (1, "alice"), (2, "albert"), (4, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "al", 10),
            [(2, "albert"), (1, "alice"), (3, "alice")],
        )

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_up_to_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a"), (2, "b"), (3, "c")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(1, "a"), (2, "b")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "100% sure"), (2, "1000 sure"), (3, "100x")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% sure")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a_b"), (2, "ab"), (3, "axb")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a\\b"), (2, "ab")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\b")])

    def test_injection_payload_is_treated_as_text(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "alice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone(), (1,))

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_at_least_one(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a"), (2, "b"), (3, "c")])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_one_hundred(self):
        conn = make_conn([(i, f"user{i:03d}") for i in range(1, 151)])
        rows = search(conn, "user", 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (1, "user001"))

    def test_valid_limit_is_applied_exactly(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a"), (2, "b"), (3, "c")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(1, "a"), (2, "b")])

    def test_non_integer_limits_are_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a")])
        for bad in (True, False, "5", 5.0, None, b"5"):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, 1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def names(self, rows):
        return [name for _, name in rows]

    def test_prefix_match(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "albert", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "al", 10)), ["albert", "alice"])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100% off", "1000 items"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "100%", 10)), ["100% off"])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_b", "axb"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "a_", 10)), ["a_b"])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["C\\dir", "Cdir"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "C\\", 10)), ["C\\dir"])

    def test_trailing_backslash_does_not_break_query(self):
        conn = make_db(["abc"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "abc\\", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(conn, "bob", 10)), ["bob"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_db(["carol", "alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.names(search(conn, "", 10)), ["alice", "bob", "carol"]
        )

    def test_ordering_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(3, "ann"), (1, "ann"), (2, "bob"), (5, "ann")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "", 10),
            [(1, "ann"), (3, "ann"), (5, "ann"), (2, "bob")],
        )

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 2)), 2)

    def test_limit_below_one_clamps_to_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", -50)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_hundred_clamps_to_hundred(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 500)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in [2.0, "5", None, [1]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, None, 5)

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_conn(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
        [(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(names, start=1)],
    )
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_matches_prefix(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "alfred", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "al", 10), [(1, "alice"), (2, "alfred")])

    def test_does_not_match_infix(self):
        conn = make_conn(["xalice", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "ali", 10), [])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["100% pure", "100x", "100"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% pure")])

    def test_lone_percent_does_not_match_everything(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a_b", "axb", "ab"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\b", "axb"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\b")])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\%x", "a\\zx", "a%x"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\%", 10), [(1, "a\\%x")])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_conn(["bob", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(2, "alice"), (1, "bob")])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, payload, 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(
            conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone(), (2,)
        )

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_conn(["sam", "sam", "sal", "sam"])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "s", 10),
            [(3, "sal"), (1, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (4, "sam")],
        )

    def test_limit_restricts_results_after_ordering(self):
        conn = make_conn(["c", "a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(2, "a"), (3, "b")])

    def test_limit_zero_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 0), [(2, "a")][:1] or [(2, "a")])

    def test_negative_limit_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_large_limit_is_clamped_to_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 500)), 100)

    def test_huge_limit_does_not_overflow(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 2**80)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limits(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


ROWS = [
    (1, "alice"),
    (2, "Alan"),
    (3, "al%ice"),
    (4, "al_x"),
    (5, "a\\b"),
    (6, "alxx"),
    (7, "ab"),
    (8, "alice"),
    (9, "zed"),
]


def make_conn(rows=ROWS):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = make_conn()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al%", 100), [(3, "al%ice")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al_", 100), [(4, "al_x")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 100), [(5, "a\\b")])

    def test_wildcard_only_prefix_matches_only_itself(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 100), [(3, "al%ice")][:0] or [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "_", 100), [])

    def test_empty_prefix_returns_all_rows_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "", 100),
            [(2, "Alan"), (7, "ab"), (3, "al%ice"), (4, "al_x"),
             (1, "alice"), (8, "alice"), (6, "alxx"), (9, "zed")],
        )

    def test_ties_are_ordered_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "alice", 100), [(1, "alice"), (8, "alice")])

    def test_injection_payload_is_treated_as_text(self):
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, payload, 100), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, len(ROWS))

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 3)), 3)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([(i, f"bulk{i:03d}") for i in range(150)])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "bulk", 1000)), 100)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_at_least_1(self):
        conn = make_conn([(i, f"bulk{i:03d}") for i in range(5)])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "bulk", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "bulk", -5)), 1)

    def test_bool_limit_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "al", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "al", False)

    def test_non_int_limit_is_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "al", bad)

    def test_non_str_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        names = [
            "alice",
            "alpha",
            "100% sure",
            "100 sure",
            "a_b",
            "axb",
            "back\\slash",
            "backx",
            "dup",
            "dup",
            "Zed",
        ]
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(names, start=1)],
        )

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def names(self, prefix, limit=100):
        return [row[1] for row in search(self.conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_plain_prefix_matches_and_is_sorted(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("al"), ["alice", "alpha"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        rows = search(self.conn, "", 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (11, "Zed")[::-1][::-1] if False else rows[0])
        self.assertEqual([r[1] for r in rows], sorted(r[1] for r in rows))
        dups = [r for r in rows if r[1] == "dup"]
        self.assertEqual([r[0] for r in dups], [9, 10])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("100%"), ["100% sure"])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("a_"), ["a_b"])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("back\\"), ["back\\slash"])

    def test_wildcard_only_prefix_matches_nothing_unexpected(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("%"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("_"), [])

    def test_injection_attempt_is_treated_as_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("x' OR '1'='1"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("alice' --"), [])

    def test_limit_is_applied_after_ordering(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("", 2), ["100 sure", "100% sure"])

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_hundred_is_clamped_to_hundred(self):
        for i in range(200):
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", (1000 + i, f"bulk{i:03d}"))
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "bulk", 500)), 100)

    def test_bool_limit_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_non_integer_limits_are_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("5", 2.0, None, [1]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import csv
import io
import re

_HEADER = ["name", "age"]
_AGE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9]+")
_MAX_AGE = 130


def read_people(text):
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""), strict=True)
    try:
        header = next(reader, None)
        if header != _HEADER:
            raise ValueError(f"expected header {_HEADER!r}, got {header!r}")

        people = []
        for row in reader:
            line = reader.line_num
            if len(row) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: expected 2 columns, got {len(row)}")
            name, age = row
            if not _AGE_PATTERN.fullmatch(age):
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: invalid age {age!r}")
            age_value = int(age)
            if age_value > _MAX_AGE:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: age {age_value} exceeds {_MAX_AGE}")
            people.append({"name": name, "age": age_value})
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid CSV: {exc}") from exc
    return people

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,25\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 25}],
        )

    def test_header_only_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\r\nAlice,30\r\nBob,25\r\n"),
            [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 25}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_comma(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Doe, Jane",41\n'),
            [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 41}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_newline(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Line one\nLine two",7\nBob,8\n'),
            [
                {"name": "Line one\nLine two", "age": 7},
                {"name": "Bob", "age": 8},
            ],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_crlf(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\r\n"a\r\nb",7\r\n'),
            [{"name": "a\r\nb", "age": 7}],
        )

    def test_doubled_quotes_inside_quoted_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"say ""hi""",3\n'),
            [{"name": 'say "hi"', "age": 3}],
        )

    def test_age_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\nA,0\nB,130\n"),
            [{"name": "A", "age": 0}, {"name": "B", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_leading_zeros_are_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\nA,007\n"), [{"name": "A", "age": 7}])

    def test_wrong_header_raises(self):
        for text in [
            "",
            "Name,Age\nAlice,30\n",
            "age,name\nAlice,30\n",
            "name\nAlice\n",
            "name,age,city\nAlice,30,X\n",
            "name,age\n\n",
            "\n",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_missing_column_raises(self):
        for text in ["name,age\nAlice\n", "name,age\nAlice,\n", "name,age\n,\n"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_extra_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30,extra\n")

    def test_comma_inside_unquoted_name_is_extra_column(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nDoe, Jane,41\n")

    def test_blank_line_in_data_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\n\nBob,25\n")

    def test_unclosed_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice,30\n')

    def test_text_after_closing_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice"x,30\n')

    def test_invalid_ages_raise(self):
        for age in [
            "",
            "abc",
            "-1",
            "+5",
            " 5",
            "5 ",
            "5.0",
            "1e2",
            "0x1F",
            "٣٠",  # Arabic-Indic digits
            "131",
            "999999999999999999999999",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nAlice,{age}\n")

    def test_error_on_later_row_rejects_whole_input(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,200\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import utc_day_start


class UtcDayStartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertDay(self, text, expected):
        result = utc_day_start(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(*expected, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        self.assertIs(result.tzinfo, timezone.utc)

    def test_positive_offset_moves_instant_to_previous_utc_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:30:00+02:00", (2024, 12, 31))

    def test_negative_offset_moves_instant_to_next_utc_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T23:30:00-02:00", (2025, 1, 2))

    def test_offset_at_exact_utc_midnight_stays_on_same_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T02:00:00+02:00", (2025, 1, 1))

    def test_z_suffix_is_utc(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-06-15T23:59:59.999999Z", (2025, 6, 15))
        self.assertDay("2025-06-15T00:00:00Z", (2025, 6, 15))

    def test_fractional_seconds_are_discarded_after_day_resolution(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-06-15T12:34:56.789+00:00", (2025, 6, 15))

    def test_leap_day_with_negative_offset_rolls_to_march_first(self):
        self.assertDay("2024-02-29T23:30:00-01:00", (2024, 3, 1))

    def test_leap_day_itself_is_preserved(self):
        self.assertDay("2024-02-29T12:00:00Z", (2024, 2, 29))
        self.assertDay("2024-02-29T00:30:00+01:00", (2024, 2, 28))

    def test_non_leap_year_march_first_with_positive_offset_rolls_back_to_february(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-03-01T00:30:00+02:00", (2025, 2, 28))

    def test_result_is_utc_midnight(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T13:45:10+05:30")
        self.assertEqual(result.hour, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.minute, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.second, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.microsecond, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.utcoffset().total_seconds(), 0)

    def test_naive_timestamp_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:30:00")

    def test_naive_timestamp_with_fraction_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2024-02-29T23:59:59.5")

    def test_invalid_inputs_are_rejected(self):
        invalid = [
            "",
            "not a timestamp",
            "2025-02-30T00:00:00Z",
            "2025-13-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2025-01-01T25:00:00Z",
            "2025-01-01T00:00:00+24:00",
            "2025-01-01T00:00:00 Z",
            "2025-01-01T00:00:00+02:00junk",
        ]
        for text in invalid:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    utc_day_start(text)

    def test_non_string_input_is_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 1700000000, datetime(2025, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    utc_day_start(value)

    def test_offset_pushing_past_year_one_boundary_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("0001-01-01T00:00:00+01:00")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def decode_chunks(chunks: Iterable[bytes]) -> str:

import pathlib
import sqlite3
import unittest

QUERY = (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src" / "solution.sql").read_text()

SCHEMA = (
    "CREATE TABLE events ("
    "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, "
    "happened_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT)"
)


def run_query(rows):
    con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    con.execute(SCHEMA)
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO events VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    return con.execute(QUERY).fetchall()


class SolutionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fixture(self):
        rows = [
            (5, 20, "2023-06-01T00:00:00Z", "older high id"),
            (4, 20, "2023-12-31T23:59:59Z", "latest for 20"),
            (1, 10, "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "older"),
            (2, 10, "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z", "tie, lower id"),
            (3, 10, "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z", "tie, higher id"),
        ]
        expected = [
            (3, 10, "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z", "tie, higher id"),
            (4, 20, "2023-12-31T23:59:59Z", "latest for 20"),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(run_query(rows), expected)

    def test_empty_table_yields_no_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(run_query([]), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.base = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = self.base / "root"
        self.sibling = self.base / "sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        (self.root / "real" / "file.txt").write_text("ok")

        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "escape_dir")
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "escape_file")
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        os.symlink(self.root / "real", self.root / "inside_dir")

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def test_accepts_existing_nested_file(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "real/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "real" / "file.txt")

    def test_accepts_nonexistent_nested_target_without_creating_it(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "new/deeper/upload.bin")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "new" / "deeper" / "upload.bin")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "new").exists())

    def test_returns_path_inside_root_for_symlink_inside_root(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "inside_dir/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "real" / "file.txt")

    def test_rejects_absolute_path(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "real" / "file.txt"))

    def test_rejects_absolute_path_to_sibling(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "x.txt"))

    def test_rejects_root_itself(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "real/..", "real/../"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_parent_traversal_to_sibling(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../sibling/new.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_to_sibling_sharing_name_prefix(self):
        evil = self.base / "root-evil"
        evil.mkdir()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-evil/x.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_hidden_after_nested_component(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "real/../../sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlinked_directory_pointing_outside(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape_dir/secret.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlinked_file_pointing_outside(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape_file")

    def test_rejects_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlinked_root_is_resolved(self):
        link_root = self.base / "root_link"
        os.symlink(self.root, link_root)
        result = resolve_upload(link_root, "real/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "real" / "file.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.root / "file.txt").write_text("ok")
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_existing_file_inside_root_is_returned(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "file.txt")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_allowed_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_dot_components_that_stay_inside_root_are_allowed(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "file.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "file.txt"))

    def test_root_itself_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in [".", "", "a/..", "./"]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_symlink_to_root_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.root, self.root / "loop")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop")

    def test_parent_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ["..", "../sibling/secret.txt", "a/../../sibling/secret.txt"]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_sibling_sharing_name_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        evil = self.root.parent / "root-evil"
        evil.mkdir()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-evil/new.txt")

    def test_symlinked_directory_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/secret.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/new.txt")

    def test_symlinked_file_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "secret_link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "secret_link")

    def test_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_pointing_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        os.symlink(self.root / "file.txt", self.root / "alias")
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "alias")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "file.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp_dir.cleanup)
        self.tmp = Path(tmp_dir.name).resolve()
        self.root = self.tmp / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = self.tmp / "root_sibling"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").write_text("x")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_returned_without_creating_it(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_rejects_absolute_path(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "new.txt"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "/etc/passwd")

    def test_rejects_root_itself(self):
        for supplied in ("", ".", "a/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_traversal_outside_root(self):
        for supplied in ("../x.txt", "a/../../x.txt", "../root_sibling/secret.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_directory(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link")
        for supplied in ("link", "link/new.txt", "link/secret.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_symlink_to_outside_file(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "file_link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "file_link")

    def test_rejects_dangling_symlink_to_outside(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_allows_symlink_that_stays_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "real", self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/x.txt"),
            self.root / "real" / "x.txt",
        )

    def test_symlinked_root_is_accepted(self):
        root_link = self.tmp / "root_link"
        os.symlink(self.root, root_link)
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(root_link, "x.txt"), self.root / "x.txt")

    def test_symlink_loop_is_reported_as_value_error(self):
        os.symlink("loop", self.root / "loop")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop/x.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"

        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "file.txt")

        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_nested_existing_directory_is_allowed(self):
        (self.root / "a" / "b").mkdir(parents=True)
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "file.txt"))

    def test_absolute_path_to_sibling_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))

    def test_target_equal_to_root_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "a/..", "a/../."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_parent_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root_evil/secret.txt")

    def test_traversal_to_sibling_by_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root_evil")

    def test_traversal_through_nonexistent_component_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "missing/../../root_evil/x")

    def test_symlink_to_sibling_directory_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/secret.txt")

    def test_symlink_to_sibling_file_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "link.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "real", self.root / "link")
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "link/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "real" / "file.txt")

    def test_symlink_then_parent_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/../root_evil/secret.txt")

    def test_returns_path_instance(self):
        self.assertIsInstance(resolve_upload(str(self.root), "f"), Path)

Wild thyme grows between the rocks on the southern slope of the ridge.
The railway reached the coast in the spring of a dry year, and the station is still in use.
Otters were seen again in the estuary after the water grew clean once more.
The clock tower chimes on the hour, and the sound carries across the fields.
A small orchard behind the farmhouse holds apples, pears and two old quince trees.
Fishing boats leave before dawn and return with the tide in the early afternoon.
The museum displays a loom that weavers in the district used for linen and wool.
Snow rarely settles on the coast, though the high moor is white for weeks each winter.
The bridge has seven arches, and the central one is wide enough for barges to pass.
Bees from the hives near the church gather nectar from clover and lime blossom.
On clear nights the stars over the moor are bright enough to cast faint shadows.
The market sells cheese, honey, wool and baskets woven from willow grown nearby.
Herons stand still in the shallows and wait for small fish to come within reach.
An old canal links the two towns, and its towpath is now a path for walkers.
The village hall hosts a choir on Thursdays and a dance on the first Saturday of the month.
Moss covers the north side of the stone walls that divide the upland pastures.
In summer the meadows are full of buttercups, ox-eye daisies and tall grasses.
The ferry crosses the sound twice a day when the weather is calm enough.
A row of cottages faces the green, each with a garden of roses and lavender.
The forest to the east was planted with oak and ash after the great storm.
Gulls trail the plough in spring, picking worms from the freshly turned soil.
The potter fires her kiln with wood, and the ash leaves a glaze of its own on the jars.
Evening brings a cool wind off the sea, and the smell of salt drifts inland.
